==Biography==

Lwx had a brief stint on [[Tan Chi Sa Gaming]] in 2016 but it wasn't successful. He joined [[Newbee]] in December of 2016. In the [[LPL/2017_Season/Spring_Season|2017 LPL Spring Season]], Newbee finished 4th in their group with 6 wins and 10 losses. In their [[LPL/2017_Season/Spring_Playoffs|playoffs]] run although they defeated [[Invictus Gaming]] 3-1, team lost 0-3 to [[EDward Gaming]] in the Quarterfinals. In the [[Demacia_Cup/2017_Season|2017 Demacia Cup]] they finished 13th-20th after a 1-2 loss to [[Young Glory]]. Their [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Season|summer season]] in the LPL went similar to their spring run. They placed 3rd in their group with 9 wins and 7 losses. In the [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Playoffs|playoffs]] they swept [[Snake Esports]] 3-0 in the first round but then got swept themselves 0-3 by [[Team WE]] in the Quarterfinals.

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Lwx''' stands for his real name (Lin Wei-Xiang). On [[Tan Chi Sa Gaming]], all of the players used their initials as their IDs.
* Lwx is the first player in Worlds's history to not die a single time in the Final.
** Four years later, [[T1]]'s bot laner [[Gumayusi]] is the second player to not die a single time in the Final of World Championship. 
* Took care of a stray cat that was wandering around FPX's training facility.<ref>[https://www.instagram.com/p/CKorjVJnfOH/] FPX's Instagram post</ref>
** It's been since added to [https://lol.gamepedia.com/File:Skin_Splash_FPX_Vayne.jpg FPX Vayne] skin's recall animation.
** It's also been nicknamed '''Wutong''' by fans.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on July 24, 2019.
** The 20th player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on 12 January, 2021.
** The 11th player to reach 1500 Kills in the LPL, after [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[Rookie]], [[Cool]], [[Smlz]], [[Mystic]], [[Xiaohu]], [[Xiye]], [[imp]], [[Doinb]] and [[Scout]].
** His 1500th kill was on [[Oh My God]] in the [[LPL/2021 Season/Spring Season|LPL 2021 Spring Split]] with {{ci|Kai'sa}}.
* Reached 2000 kills in the LPL on 26 January, 2022.
** The 8th player to reach 2000 Kills in the LPL, after [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[Rookie]], [[Smlz]], [[Xiaohu]] ,[[Xiye]], [[Doinb]] and [[Scout]].
** His 2000th kill was on [[LNG Esports]]'s support [[LvMao]] in the [[LPL/2022 Season/Spring Season|LPL 2022 Spring Split]] with {{ci|Aphelios}}.
* Reached 2500 kills in the LPL on June 24, 2023.
** The 5th player to reach 2500 Kills in the LPL, after [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[Rookie]], [[xiaohu]] and [[Scout]].
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on July 6th, 2022.
** The 11th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL after [[Clearlove]], [[meiko]], [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[Doinb]], [[Scout]], [[Flandre]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], and [[xiye]].
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on June 13, 2022
** The 13th player to reach 500 games in the LPL, after [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]], [[meiko]], [[Rookie]], [[xiaohu]], [[Xiye]], [[Flandre]], [[Smlz]], [[Doinb]], [[Scout]], [[cold]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], and [[Sofm]].
* Reached 600 games in the LPL on June 23, 2023
** The 8th player to reach 600 games in the LPL after [[Rookie]], [[meiko]], [[xiaohu]], [[Flandre]], [[Doinb]], [[Scout]], and [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]].
* Reached 2000 assists in the LPL on 7 April, 2021.
** His 2000th assist was on [[Royal Never Give Up]] in the [[LPL/2021 Season/Spring Playoffs|2021 Spring Playoffs]].
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on March 12th, 2023.
** The 21st player and 1st bot laner to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
